title: Curated team
description: One row of data/curated/teams.jsonl: a team the corpus references, with the display name and region the source states. Its canonical ID is anchored on the root of the source's rename chain (see tools/dataset/identity.ts), so it survives a rebrand; the other strings that denote this team are rows in aliases.jsonl. Contains no build timestamp, so the file is byte-identical across builds (spec R8).

id.description: Opaque surrogate key derived from the source identity (spec D3). Do not parse it: read the row through `name`.

name.description: The team's current display name as the source states it, so the row reads without decoding the ID (spec R12).

overviewPage.description: The team's current wiki page. Null only when a scoreboard cited a team the source registers no page for: that entity is minted, and reported in identity-unresolved.jsonl, rather than dropped.

region.description: The source's Region string, verbatim. Empty when the source records none — including for a minted entity, whose region nobody recorded.
